newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,449 to dollar for Nov 8 to 10 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,449 to dollar for Nov 8 to 10 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 3,449 to the dollar for November 8 to 10.
This reference rate was set on Wednesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Tuesday for November 7 is 3,430 to the dollar. It was 3,420 on Wednesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
